final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.order_count) AS avg_order_count, AVG(g.order_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_difference FROM gender_counts AS g JOIN overall_average AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE g.order_count > a.avg_count
